reconstructed_theorem_text:
Let E be the full finite-dimensional real Hilbert space with its Borel measurable structure and canonical ordinary volume, including dimension zero. All approved section instances belong to the contract. Let mu:Measure E be any finite measure. Let D:Lp R 2 mu ->partialLinear[R] Lp E 2 mu be supplied and closable, with exactly this original graph: For every scalar class a and vector class H in these actual quotient spaces, (a,H) belongs to D.graph if and only if there exists a smooth compactly supported real function phi:E->R with a=phi almost everywhere for the stated measure and H=gradient(phi) almost everywhere for that same measure. D is the genuine real-linear partial gradient on its submodule domain; D.closure is its actual same-graph closure operator. For every supplied real c there exists u in this SAME D.closure.domain such that the standard representative of the scalar quotient u equals the actual constant function x->c mu-almost everywhere, and D.closure(u)=0 as the actual vector L2(mu) quotient.
D is fixed before c, and u may depend on c. Both domain membership and zero output are produced rather than assumed for constants. No probability/positive density/absolute continuity is required of finite mu, and zero measure is not excluded. This is an existential constant-domain witness for each c, not a uniqueness or arbitrary-u kernel characterization by itself. It adds no spectral-gap or further inequality, measurable simultaneous selection, core/adjoint or composition conclusion.
objects: Arbitrary finite mu,original supplied closable exact smooth-compact gradient D,each real constant c,actual closure-domain u witness and genuine vector zero output.
domains: Full finite real Hilbert/Borel E including0; actual scalar/vector L2(mu) partial gradient. Finite mu may be zero or singular and is not required normalized. u in same D.closure.domain; standard scalar quotient representative mu-AE equals constant; output0 in vector quotient.
quantifiers: Universal E,finite mu,D under closability/exact graph; graph forall scalar a/vector H iff exists smooth compact generator; forall supplied c:R,exists u:SAME D.closure.domain with constant AE identity and zero output simultaneously. D before c,u may depend on c.
assumptions: IsFiniteMeasure mu,D closable,original graph exactly smooth compact function/gradient classes modulo mu. c arbitrary real. No constant-domain or output0 assumption; no probability/positive density/curvature/spectral-gap/density premise.
conclusion: For each c exists actual u in original closure domain linked mu-AE to constant c and with D.closure u=0.
scopes: Constant domain membership/zero output genuinely produced. This packet alone gives per-constant existence,not arbitrary-u iff characterization or uniqueness. Zero measure not excluded; no measurable simultaneous choice,rough Hessian/core/adjoint/further inequality/main/composition conclusion.
constant_dependencies: c any real,not fixed0 and not uniformly selected across all c. Quotient exponent2 and output actual vector0. No quantitative coefficient/rate; u depends mu,D,c.
